column1: # Per-sample path-aware EDP -- Monte Carlo, ALL 5 architectures, ALL widths 2-64-bit,
# 1,000,000 samples each (seed=42). For each sample: gate switch counters reset before
# that sample (switches_i = that sample's own switch count), delay_i = max real
# OpenSTA/Nangate45 delay (all_critical_paths.csv) among every (changed input pin,
# changed output pin) pair exercised by that specific sample. EDP_i = switches_i * delay_i,
# accumulated per sample, THEN averaged -- not avg_switches * avg_delay (naive, shown
# alongside for comparison). AvgSwitches verified to match the original
# monte_carlo_results.csv at every row that existed there (2-8-bit).
# TER rows FIXED 2026-11-04: now samples A/B uniformly over the SAME unsigned
# 0..2^N-1 range as RCA/CLA/SD-TC (dropped-NAF/TER-BIN encoding), instead of the
# old per-digit {-1,0,+1} trit sampling (a different, broader signed input universe
# that made TER's Monte Carlo incomparable to the other four architectures').
